records.title: “华为杯”第二十三届中国研究生数学建模竞赛
records.participation: Three graduate students; cross-institution teams only when all members are 2026 incoming graduate students; see invitation for eligibility.
deliverables: PDF paper using the official cover (team identity and four unchanged logos), then the uniform abstract and body; PDF filename problem letter + team number; final PDF MD5 submitted separately before upload

Program/results archive when required by the problem (optional when useful and disclosed); filename problem letter + team number, no identifying content except the permitted filename, <=50M; see the 2026 opening notice
records.ai: Confirmed 2026-09-16 policy: AI may assist, not replace independent thought/core innovation. Cite model/formula sources; unverified AI sources require identifying the tool/model, developer and release date with an explicit risk. Annotate AI-assisted data analysis and program source with tool/model, developer and release date. Provide AI inputs and downstream processing strategy when the chosen problem requires it. No universal CUMCM-style AI declaration/details-PDF requirement is stated in this policy.

sources.scope: 2026 official invitation: participation, submission windows and award/defense system
Official 2026-09-16 paper-format DOCX, entire document XML text read; title, abstract, typography, page marks, anonymity and citations
Official 2026-09-16 opening notice: cover/abstract order, cover identity and four unchanged logos, subsequent anonymity, two-page abstract maximum, filename, MD5/upload and <=50M attachment window
Official 2026-09-16 AI policy, entire DOCX XML text read; clauses 1-9, use-specific attribution and problem-dependent input/processing details

Official 2026 template is legacy Word DOC despite a misleading local .docx extension; textutil read cover labels 学校/参赛队号/队员姓名 and subsequent uniform abstract. The four logos were not visually certified in this audit

records.limits: Rules remain partial and workflow unvalidated. The default document_kind=report checks an anonymous abstract/body report and does not certify a full submission. Submission mode checks recognized cover labels, abstract on PDF page 2, logical page numbers from abstract 1, and configured forbidden terms only after the cover. Four original logos, exact template layout, all identifying information, filename/upload/MD5, abstract boundary, typography and AI-use attribution truth require further checks or review. No end-to-end validation or award calibration.
